scope: One entry for every script in scripts/archive/ and for each fixture generator moved out of it. invocation is appended to the script path (.py runs with the current Python, .sh with bash) from the repository root; expected_exit is its exit status without the native extension; mutates says whether that invocation writes, deletes or rewrites any file; native says what real use needs (none, optional for a non-default mode, required for the documented use, import when importing the script needs chronicler_agents); inputs describe what real use reads; fixture_outputs are checked-in files the script regenerates when asked to. A smoke run checks only the exit status and that nothing changed; it does not qualify a script's results. scripts/testing/script_smoke.py runs the safe_to_run entries in a detached temporary worktree of HEAD; tests/test_script_smoke_manifest.py checks this file statically.
